newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JAN 13.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JAN 13.

text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
- Lawyer Marta Tocsik is said to have whitdrawn those parts of her confession to police which were connected to government politicians.
- The Socialist Party would like to see a swift conclusion in the Tocsik-inquiry.
- The Romanian Foreign Ministry has called back the deputy head of the Romanian Clutlral Centre in Budapest and Romanian television's Budapest correspondent.
- The Ministry of Culture and Education has started a conflict of interest screening of its employees.
- Irregularities at the social security self-governments triggered stricter government scrutiny to be done by the Finance and Welfare Ministry.
